title: Infostealer suspicious public network egress from LOLBins (step 3 of 3)
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Step 3 of correlated infostealer detection: public egress from common LOLBins or loaders. Correlate with step 1 (execution) and step 2 (credential-store access) within a short time window (<=10 minutes). IPv6 private ranges (::1, fe80::, fc00::/7) and IPv4 link-local (169.254.) are filtered in addition to RFC1918 ranges.
